items.title: Advanced Supervised Windows Agent
items.expectedBehavior: Max merencanakan, meminta izin, mengeksekusi, memverifikasi, dan melaporkan aksi.
items.speed: Fast path untuk aksi aman; deep planner untuk workflow kompleks
items.responsePattern: Rencana: scan log, cek config, backup file, usulkan patch, jalankan test. Konfirmasi setiap perubahan.
items.implementationHint: Planner, permission engine, executor, verifier, audit, rollback.
items.dataNeeded: Allowed scope, task goal, action graph, risk labels.

items.title: Windows UI Automation via UIA
items.objective: Mengontrol elemen UI lebih stabil daripada koordinat mouse.
items.expectedBehavior: Max mengenali window, button, textbox, menu, dan dialog.
items.responsePattern: Aku menemukan window dan tombol Settings. Klik setelah konfirmasi?
items.implementationHint: Microsoft UI Automation selector; fallback screenshot.
items.dataNeeded: Window handles, automation IDs, element roles.
items.limits: Aplikasi tanpa accessibility tree perlu mode visual.
items.guardrail: Jangan klik transaksi, password, atau penghapusan tanpa konfirmasi.

items.title: Vision-based Desktop Understanding
items.objective: Memahami kondisi layar dan perubahan UI.
items.expectedBehavior: Max membandingkan screenshot sebelum/sesudah aksi.
items.responsePattern: Terminal menunjukkan server aktif. Akurasi visual: 90%.
items.implementationHint: OCR, visual element detection, state diff.
items.dataNeeded: Before/after screenshots, OCR text, active app.

items.title: PowerShell Orchestration Layer
items.objective: Menjalankan workflow Windows melalui PowerShell secara terkontrol.
items.expectedBehavior: Max membaca service, event log, process, network, package, dan environment.
items.responsePattern: Aku akan menjalankan pengecekan status saja. Tidak ada perubahan sistem.
items.implementationHint: Local scripts, constrained execution, timeout.
items.dataNeeded: Command modules, risk metadata, outputs.
items.guardrail: Jangan jalankan script internet tanpa review.

items.title: WSL and Linux Integration
items.expectedBehavior: Max memilih PowerShell, CMD, atau WSL sesuai project.
items.responsePattern: Aku pilih WSL karena environment project ada di Linux. Jalankan test? [Y/N]
items.implementationHint: Shell detector, path translator, environment registry.
items.dataNeeded: OS, WSL distro, project environment, commands.

items.title: Project-aware Desktop Workspace
items.objective: Mengikat aplikasi, folder, terminal, dan memory ke satu project.
items.expectedBehavior: Max tahu resource mana milik workspace aktif.
items.responsePattern: Workspace aktif: NusaMind. Folder, terminal, dan file terakhir siap dipakai.
items.implementationHint: Workspace manifest + allowed resources.
items.dataNeeded: Project root, apps, commands, environment, artifacts.

items.title: Safe File Editing with Patch
items.expectedBehavior: Max membuat patch, preview, backup, lalu menerapkan setelah persetujuan.
items.responsePattern: Aku sudah membuat diff. Belum diterapkan. Review lalu konfirmasi.
items.implementationHint: Unified diff, checksum, atomic write, backup.
items.dataNeeded: Original file, proposed patch, test plan.
items.guardrail: Secret dimasking; jangan overwrite tanpa backup.

items.title: System Restore and Snapshot Planning
items.objective: Membuat titik pemulihan atau backup sebelum perubahan besar.
items.expectedBehavior: Max menyarankan restore point atau backup sesuai risiko.
items.userExample: Install driver dan ubah setting sistem.
items.responsePattern: Risiko tinggi. Disarankan restore point dan backup sebelum melanjutkan.
items.implementationHint: Restore-point integration + fallback backup.
items.dataNeeded: Risk level, available recovery methods.
items.guardrail: Tidak ubah driver/registry tanpa recovery dan izin.

items.title: Event-driven Verification
items.expectedBehavior: Max memeriksa exit code, service status, diff, dan screenshot hasil.
items.confirmation: Otomatis read-only; konfirmasi bila test mengubah data
items.responsePattern: Test lulus dan error tidak muncul. Confidence: 92%.
items.implementationHint: Action-specific verification adapters.
items.dataNeeded: Expected state, actual state, logs, screenshots.
items.limits: Tidak semua aplikasi punya test otomatis.

items.title: Permission Tokens and Expiry
items.objective: Membatasi izin berdasarkan durasi dan scope.
items.expectedBehavior: Akses folder/app kedaluwarsa otomatis.
items.responsePattern: Izin read-only aktif 15 menit untuk folder tersebut.
items.implementationHint: Permission token with scope, expiry, revocation.
items.dataNeeded: Scope, mode, expiry, user consent.

items.title: Advanced Process and Service Diagnostics
items.expectedBehavior: Max menghubungkan crash, dependency, port, dan resource.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek service, port conflict, log, permission, dan data directory.
items.implementationHint: Service dependency graph + port scanner + log parser.
items.dataNeeded: Service status, ports, logs, permissions.
items.guardrail: Jangan restart service kritis tanpa izin.

items.title: Network Diagnostics Agent
items.expectedBehavior: Max menjalankan ping, DNS, route, port check, adapter, firewall read-only.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek service, port listening, firewall, hosts file read-only, dan URL.
items.implementationHint: Diagnostic command bundle with timeout.
items.dataNeeded: IP config, DNS, routes, listening ports, service state.
items.guardrail: Jangan buka port atau nonaktifkan keamanan otomatis.

items.title: Package and Runtime Manager
items.expectedBehavior: Max memeriksa versi, lockfile, environment, dan rencana install/update.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek runtime, lockfile, package manager, dan konflik versi sebelum install.
items.implementationHint: Adapters npm/pip/composer/winget/choco/apt dengan risk control.
items.dataNeeded: Manifest, lockfiles, runtime versions, package metadata.

items.title: Browser Automation Expert
items.objective: Mendukung workflow web lokal dan debugging browser.
items.expectedBehavior: Max membaca console/network, screenshot, dan mengetes form.
items.responsePattern: Aku inspeksi console, request network, response API, dan validasi form.
items.implementationHint: Playwright dengan domain allowlist.
items.dataNeeded: Allowed domains, test data, console/network logs.
items.guardrail: Jangan login rekening/trading atau menekan beli/jual.

items.title: Desktop Action Audit and Replay
items.expectedBehavior: Max menunjukkan rencana/hasil dan mengulang workflow non-destruktif.
items.responsePattern: Aku dapat mengulang workflow read-only yang sama setelah konfirmasi.
items.implementationHint: Structured action log dan safe replay.
items.dataNeeded: Action IDs, parameters, outputs, risk.

items.title: Emergency Stop and Kill-Switch
items.expectedBehavior: Max membatalkan process, automation, dan queue.
items.responsePattern: Semua aksi dihentikan. Tidak ada langkah lanjutan.
items.implementationHint: Cancellation token, child-process cleanup, queue clear.
items.dataNeeded: Active task IDs and process handles.

items.title: Global Cross-Asset Reasoning
items.objective: Memahami interaksi saham, obligasi, FX, komoditas, dan crypto.
items.expectedBehavior: Max menjelaskan transmisi kebijakan dan korelasi yang berubah.
items.speed: Cross-asset feature cache + selective deep analysis
items.userExample: Dampak inflasi AS ke saham, emas, dolar, crypto?
items.responsePattern: Aku buat skenario berdasarkan inflasi, ekspektasi suku bunga, real yield, likuiditas, dan risk appetite.
items.implementationHint: Cross-asset graph, regime-aware correlation model.
items.dataNeeded: Inflation, rates, yields, FX, equities, commodities, crypto, timestamps.
items.guardrail: Wajib tampilkan tanggal data dan skenario alternatif.

items.title: Macro Nowcasting Framework
items.objective: Mengestimasi kondisi ekonomi dari indikator terbaru.
items.expectedBehavior: Max menggabungkan inflasi, tenaga kerja, PMI, yield, kredit, konsumsi.
items.responsePattern: Aku menilai pertumbuhan, inflasi, tenaga kerja, dan kondisi keuangan sebagai probabilitas.
items.implementationHint: Dynamic factor/ensemble model with missing-data handling.
items.dataNeeded: Timestamped macro indicators and revisions.

items.title: IDX Equity Expert Module
items.expectedBehavior: Max memadukan fundamental, teknikal, likuiditas, aksi korporasi, sektor, dan makro.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek bisnis, laporan, valuasi, arus kas, likuiditas, aksi korporasi, dan risiko sektor.
items.implementationHint: Issuer knowledge graph and financial parser.
items.dataNeeded: Official filings, prices, volume, corporate actions, sector, BI/OJK/IDX context.
items.guardrail: Bukan rekomendasi personal; sumber dan tanggal wajib.

items.title: Global Equity Expert Module
items.objective: Menganalisis saham luar negeri dan faktor global.
items.expectedBehavior: Max memahami earnings, guidance, valuation, rates, FX, regulation, competition.
items.responsePattern: Aku pisahkan kualitas bisnis, earnings, valuasi, risiko makro, dan skenario harga.
items.implementationHint: Financial statement normalization across markets.
items.dataNeeded: Filings, earnings, guidance, prices, FX, peer data, timestamps.
items.limits: Standar akuntansi dan mata uang berbeda.
items.guardrail: Jangan memberi certainty atau instruksi transaksi.

items.title: Crypto Market Microstructure Expert
items.objective: Memahami likuiditas, leverage, funding, open interest, liquidation, exchange risk.
items.expectedBehavior: Max menjelaskan jatuh/naik tajam dengan data struktur pasar.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek leverage, funding, open interest, liquidation cascade, volume, berita, dan likuiditas.
items.implementationHint: Exchange data adapters dan microstructure features.
items.dataNeeded: Price, volume, order book summary, funding, OI, liquidations, timestamp.
items.guardrail: Wajib sebut sumber exchange dan timestamp.

items.title: On-chain Analysis Expert
items.expectedBehavior: Max menganalisis active addresses, flows, concentration, exchange inflow/outflow, supply.
items.prediction: On-chain scenario signal, bukan target pasti
items.responsePattern: Aku cek konsentrasi holder, unlock, exchange flows, aktivitas jaringan, dan likuiditas.
items.implementationHint: On-chain provider abstraction and anomaly detection.
items.dataNeeded: Verified on-chain metrics, token supply/unlock, timestamps.
items.guardrail: Jangan anggap satu metrik sebagai sinyal pasti.

items.title: Multi-Horizon Forecast Router
items.expectedBehavior: Max membedakan intraday, harian, mingguan, bulanan, jangka panjang.
items.prediction: Model berbeda per horizon + scenario ensemble
items.responsePattern: Aku pakai fitur/model bulanan, bukan sinyal intraday; hasil berupa skenario probabilistik.
items.implementationHint: Horizon classifier and model registry.
items.dataNeeded: Time-series data sesuai horizon.
items.guardrail: Wajib sebut horizon dan interval ketidakpastian.

items.title: Probabilistic Ensemble Forecast
items.expectedBehavior: Max memakai trend, volatility, macro, fundamentals, sentiment, dan regime.
items.responsePattern: Skenario dihitung dari beberapa model; bukan kepastian tunggal.
items.implementationHint: Calibrated model ensemble with out-of-sample validation.
items.dataNeeded: Prices, volume, volatility, macro, sentiment, fundamentals.

items.title: Prediction Interval and Uncertainty
items.expectedBehavior: Max memberi interval dan faktor ketidakpastian.
items.responsePattern: Aku memberi rentang probabilistik dan asumsi, bukan target pasti.
items.implementationHint: Quantile regression/conformal interval.
items.dataNeeded: Historical residuals, volatility, forecast distribution.
items.limits: Shock ekstrem bisa di luar interval.

items.title: Market Regime and Structural Break Detection
items.expectedBehavior: Max menurunkan kepercayaan model lama saat regime berubah.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek volatilitas, korelasi, trend, likuiditas, dan structural break.
items.implementationHint: Change-point detection, HMM/regime model, drift alerts.
items.dataNeeded: Long history, correlations, volatility, liquidity.
items.limits: Regime baru baru terlihat setelah data masuk.
items.guardrail: Jangan percaya backtest lintas regime secara buta.

items.title: Walk-forward Backtesting
items.expectedBehavior: Max menggunakan data masa lalu tanpa melihat masa depan.
items.responsePattern: Aku gunakan walk-forward, biaya transaksi, dan data yang tersedia saat itu.
items.implementationHint: No look-ahead, purged splits, transaction costs.
items.dataNeeded: Timestamped history and model signals.

items.title: Forecast Calibration Monitor
items.objective: Memeriksa apakah probabilitas prediksi dapat dipercaya.
items.expectedBehavior: Max menurunkan confidence jika model tidak terkalibrasi.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek apakah prediksi historis 80% benar mendekati 80% kejadian.
items.implementationHint: Brier score, reliability analysis, recalibration.
items.dataNeeded: Historical forecasts and outcomes.

items.title: Fundamental Valuation Expert
items.objective: Membandingkan valuasi berbasis arus kas dan multiple.
items.expectedBehavior: Max membuat rentang skenario, bukan nilai tunggal mutlak.
items.responsePattern: Aku buat rentang dari asumsi pertumbuhan, margin, discount rate, dan risiko.
items.implementationHint: Formula-driven valuation engine.
items.dataNeeded: Financial statements, forecasts, discount rate, peers.

items.title: Technical and Quantitative Signal Fusion
items.expectedBehavior: Max menilai momentum, trend, volatility, volume, breadth, correlation.
items.responsePattern: Aku nilai konsistensi lintas indikator dan tidak memakai satu indikator saja.
items.implementationHint: Feature pipeline, regularization, out-of-sample tests.
items.dataNeeded: Clean OHLCV, benchmark, transaction costs.

items.title: News and Sentiment Expert
items.objective: Memahami dampak berita dengan kredibilitas dan kejutan pasar.
items.expectedBehavior: Max membedakan fakta, opini, rumor, dan priced-in.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek kredibilitas, waktu rilis, aset terkait, kejutan, dan reaksi harga.
items.implementationHint: Entity/event extraction, source ranking, surprise scoring.
items.dataNeeded: Article/headline, source, timestamp, consensus, reaction.

items.title: Portfolio Scenario and Stress Test
items.expectedBehavior: Max membuat stress scenario suku bunga, FX, saham, dan crypto.
items.userExample: Apa terjadi jika dolar naik dan saham turun?
items.responsePattern: Aku estimasikan dampak berdasarkan bobot, korelasi, mata uang, dan sensitivitas.
items.implementationHint: Exposure engine, scenario shocks, covariance estimates.
items.dataNeeded: Holdings, weights, currency, history, factor exposures.

items.title: Drawdown and Tail Risk Analysis
items.expectedBehavior: Max menghitung drawdown, VaR/CVaR secara hati-hati, dan stress history.
items.prediction: Risk distribution, not guaranteed loss cap
items.responsePattern: Aku beri distribusi risiko dan stress scenario, bukan batas kerugian pasti.
items.implementationHint: Historical simulation and robust checks.
items.dataNeeded: Returns, volatility, correlations, position sizes.

items.title: Financial Source Trust and Freshness Engine
items.expectedBehavior: Max menolak kondisi pasar terkini jika timestamp/sumber tidak valid.
items.responsePattern: Aku cek sumber, timestamp, revisi, dan konflik data.
items.implementationHint: Source registry, TTL per data type, conflict resolver.
items.dataNeeded: Source/provider, timestamp, revision status, trust score.
items.limits: Tidak ada sumber tunggal selalu benar.

items.title: Max Direct-First Finance Mode
items.objective: Menjaga Max cepat walau analisis finansial expert.
items.expectedBehavior: Max menjawab ringkas; detail lewat `/expand`.
items.responsePattern: Bias: netral-cenderung positif. Confidence: 68%. Risiko utama: suku bunga dan volatilitas. Data per [timestamp].
items.implementationHint: Compact answer schema + deferred analysis.
items.dataNeeded: Forecast, confidence, risks, timestamp.

items.title: Finance Prediction Governance
items.expectedBehavior: Max menyimpan model version, data cut-off, backtest, calibration, failure cases.
items.responsePattern: Aku bandingkan versi model, data cut-off, regime, dan calibration score.
items.implementationHint: Model registry, data lineage, evaluation reports, rollback.
items.dataNeeded: Model version, feature version, training window, metrics.
items.guardrail: Prediksi gagal evaluasi tidak boleh confidence tinggi.

Jangan restart service kritis tanpa izin.
